evals.prompt: I just bumped skills/demo-skill from 1.1.0 to 1.2.0 after adding a --dry-run step. Write the changelog entry.
evals.expected_output: demo-skill/CHANGELOG.md created with the standard header and a 1.2.0 entry whose Added section names the --dry-run step; nothing committed
expectations: skill_versions.py state ran before any file was written
The entry heading is '## [1.2.0] - YYYY-MM-DD' and sits directly under the header
The Added section mentions the --dry-run step; no empty sections exist
skill_versions.py check exited 0 after the write
No git commit, git add or git push was run
The first line of the report states the result status
Inferred bullets or untested behaviour are labelled separately from observed checks
Each material claim points to a command result or file
The report ends with the next decision or states no approval is needed

evals.expected_output: Entry for the committed current version written from the range base..bump commit; backfill offered exactly once (or, with no user present, listed as available) because the file was created and history has 2+ versions
expectations: The diff_cmd and log_cmd printed by state were the ones run
The entry version equals metadata.version in SKILL.md
Backfill was offered at most once; with no user present it was listed as 'backfill available' instead of asked
The report names the range (base..end) and the sections written

evals.prompt: I fixed the broken jq path in skills/demo-skill and bumped it to 1.2.1. demo-skill already has a CHANGELOG.md. Add the entry.
evals.expected_output: 1.2.1 entry with a Fixed section inserted above the existing 1.2.0 entry; older entries byte-identical
expectations: The new entry is above the previous top entry
The entry uses a Fixed section
Older entries are unchanged (diff of CHANGELOG.md shows only added lines)
No backfill question was asked because the file already existed

evals.prompt: Write the changelog for skills/demo-skill again; I think I forgot.
evals.expected_output: Already recorded: the current version is already the top entry, nothing written
expectations: CHANGELOG.md was not modified
The report result is 'already recorded'

evals.prompt: Write the changelog entry for /tmp/loose-skill (it is not in a git repo).
evals.expected_output: Blocked with the script's error; no file written
expectations: No CHANGELOG.md was created
The report result is 'blocked' with the reason from skill_versions.py

evals.prompt: Update the repo's top-level CHANGELOG.md for the 2.25.0 release of asm.
evals.expected_output: Handled as a project release-notes task without the skill's workflow
expectations: skill_versions.py was not run
No per-skill CHANGELOG.md was created

evals.prompt: Write a commit message for my staged changes to skills/demo-skill.
evals.expected_output: A commit message, without writing a CHANGELOG entry
expectations: No CHANGELOG.md was written or modified

evals.prompt: /skill-changelog skills/demo-skill (two versions, 1.2.1 and 1.2.2, were committed since its changelog's 1.2.0 entry)
evals.expected_output: 1.2.2 entry written; 1.2.1 reported as missing and offered (or listed) for backfill
expectations: The new top entry is 1.2.2
The report names 1.2.1 under backfill available or asks one backfill question
The 1.2.0 entry is unchanged

evals.prompt: Write the changelog entry for skills/demo-skill in this CI checkout (a --depth 1 clone).
evals.expected_output: Blocked: shallow clone, with the unshallow command; no file written
expectations: No CHANGELOG.md was created
The report says shallow clone and names git fetch --unshallow
